tagScheme.rule: Publish-once (closes R02): a tag name binds the exact build inputs — inner CRM SHA (crm12) plus the deployment HEAD the image was built from (dep12). Two different deployment commits can never share a name, so CI can never push over an existing tag: before push it inspects, and an existing tag is reused by digest, never rebuilt. Every new deployment commit mints new names (dep12 changes); the manifest digestFixup-v2 procedure reconciles names+digests afterwards.
tagScheme.retiredNote: Scheme-v1 two-segment names are RETIRED: frozen in GHCR, never republished, never overwritten, never reused for new content. The CI validator and the release schema reject them. Last recorded digests are kept in release/mahabbat-release.json retiredImmutableTags as a historical record.
